# Button

Buttons start an action on this page; links go somewhere else.

`SongNodes.Button` · Actions

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.Button>…</SongNodes.Button>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.Button">…</x-import>
```

## Props (ButtonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "quiet" \| "module" \| "danger" \| "danger-quiet"` | Visual kind; at most one "primary" per view. |
| `module` | `"graph" \| "library" \| "sets" \| "paths" \| "harmony" \| "sources" \| "pipeline" \| "services"` | Module scope for kind="module" (sets the fill colour). |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | Height: sm 32px, md 40px (default), lg 48px; all grow to 44px on touch. |
| `icon` | `string` | Lucide icon name shown before the label. |
| `iconOnly` | `boolean` | Icon-only button: the label becomes aria-label and is required. |
| `children` * | `ReactNode` | Verb-first label in sentence case ("Build set"). |
| `busy` | `boolean` | Busy: shows sn-spinner, sets aria-busy, keeps width; pass the ongoing verb as busyLabel. |
| `busyLabel` | `string` | Label while busy ("Saving…"). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disabled; prefer disabledReason so it stays focusable with aria-disabled. |
| `disabledReason` | `string` | Why it is disabled; renders aria-disabled and an associated description. |
| `pressed` | `boolean` | Toggle state for toggle buttons (aria-pressed). |
| `type` | `"button" \| "submit" \| "reset"` | Native button type; defaults to "button". |
| `onClick` | `(e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void` | Click handler. |
